title: Vale amendment to consolidated interim financial statements at June 30, 2026
publisher: Vale S.A. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
summary: The August 24 Form 6-K/A adds Exhibit 101 interactive data to Vale's July 31 interim-financial filing and explicitly states that it does not amend any other information in the original filing. It therefore adds no changed operating, balance-sheet, valuation, catalyst, or risk fact.
